note: 施肥知识库：既用于缺素问答，也用于农事日历的追肥提醒。用量以「每亩」为单位，沙质土取下限、黏质土取上限。

deficiency.zh-CN: 老叶先均匀褪绿发黄，由叶尖沿中脉向内扩展；植株矮小，分蘖分枝少。
deficiency.en-US: Older leaves yellow evenly first, spreading from tip along the midrib; plants stunted with fewer tillers.

excess.zh-CN: 植株徒长贪青，茎秆软弱易倒伏，抗病力下降，成熟推迟。
excess.en-US: Excessive vegetative growth, weak lodging-prone stems, lower disease resistance, delayed maturity.

zh-CN: 基肥深施，追肥分次施用，避免一次过量
沙质土少量多次，防止淋溶损失
叶面喷施浓度 1% 尿素，5~7 天一次
en-US: Apply basal N deep and split top-dressings
On sandy soil use small frequent doses to avoid leaching

deficiency.zh-CN: 老叶叶背和叶缘呈紫红色，叶片窄而直立；根系发育差，成熟延迟。
deficiency.en-US: Undersides and margins of older leaves turn purple-red; narrow upright leaves; poor roots, delayed maturity.

excess.zh-CN: 易固定土壤中的锌铁等微量元素，诱发缺锌；并随水土流失污染水体。
excess.en-US: Can fix zinc and iron in soil, inducing deficiency, and pollutes water when lost to runoff.

zh-CN: 磷肥全部作基肥，集中施在根系附近
低温季节配合有机肥提高地温与吸收率
叶面用 0.3% 磷酸二氢钾，连喷 2~3 次
en-US: Apply all P as basal fertiliser placed near roots
Combine with organic matter in cold seasons

deficiency.zh-CN: 老叶叶缘先焦枯发黄，由边缘向内蔓延；茎秆软弱，果实着色差、不耐储。
deficiency.en-US: Older leaf margins scorch and yellow inward; weak stems; poor fruit colouring and storage.

excess.zh-CN: 影响钙镁吸收，造成果实脐腐或叶片边缘坏死；浪费成本。
excess.en-US: Interferes with calcium and magnesium uptake, causing blossom-end rot or marginal necrosis; wastes cost.

zh-CN: 喜钾作物（马铃薯、烟草、葡萄）用硫酸钾，不用氯化钾
膨大期和着色期是需钾高峰，提前 7 天追施
en-US: Use potassium sulphate for chloride-sensitive crops
Peak demand at bulking and colouring; top-dress 7 days ahead
Always combine with N and P

deficiency.zh-CN: 缺锌：新叶变小簇生（小叶病）。缺铁：新叶叶脉间失绿，叶脉仍绿。缺镁：老叶叶脉间失绿。缺硼：生长点坏死、花而不实。
deficiency.en-US: Zn: small clustered new leaves. Fe: interveinal chlorosis on new leaves with green veins. Mg: interveinal chlorosis on old leaves. B: growing point necrosis and poor fruit set.

excess.zh-CN: 微量元素安全范围窄，过量易造成毒害，务必按说明稀释。
excess.en-US: Micronutrients have a narrow safe range; overdosing causes toxicity, so always follow the label.

zh-CN: 以叶面喷施为主，见效快、用量省
碱性土壤最容易缺锌缺铁，可配施有机肥
开花前补硼，坐果后补钙
en-US: Prefer foliar sprays - fast acting and low dose
Alkaline soils most often lack Zn and Fe; add organic matter
Boron before flowering, calcium after fruit set

tip.en-US: Light starter fertiliser, avoid rank growth
Reduce N, increase K to prevent flower drop
Rely on basal fertiliser, little top-dressing
Ear fertiliser - determines ear size and grain number
Ear fertiliser, apply according to crop appearance
